title: Deterministic Zero-Trust: Trust as a Computable, Decaying, Revocable, Cryptographically-Bounded Physical Quantity
description: We introduce Deterministic Zero-Trust (DZT), a security architecture where trust is not a confidence score but a physical quantity governed by conservation laws, mandatory decay, cryptographic scoping, and cascading invalidation. We prove seven formal security guarantees unachievable by probabilistic systems, demonstrated across 15 implemented security primitives.
